name: scroll-lit-paragraph
title: Scroll Lit Paragraph
description: A long paragraph where words illuminate one by one as scroll progress passes them — reading position made spatial, like a cursor of light sweeping through the copy as the page moves.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Editorial
Macrostructure: Stack
Density: Medium
Shape: Sharp
Motion: Subtle
Typography: Grotesk
Color: Accent Only

## Rules

- Scroll Progress Trigger: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
